platform_intro: Every business on the system: what it subscribed to, what it paid, and what is waiting for you.
platform_receipts_waiting: {count} bank transfer receipts are waiting to be checked.
platform_messages_waiting: {count} messages from the contact page have not been answered.
platform_attention_hint: Businesses whose payment is late or that are blocked, and trials ending within three days.
platform_attention_none: Nobody is late and no trial is about to end.
platform_businesses_intro: Open a business to change its package, extend it, record a payment or suspend it.
platform_change_subscription_hint: Takes effect at once. It records no payment.
platform_paid_until_hint: The last day the business may work without paying again.
platform_complimentary_hint: Never runs out and is never asked to pay
platform_record_payment_hint: For money taken by hand: cash, a cheque, a courtesy. It counts at once and extends the subscription by the package's period.
platform_record_note_placeholder: Cash at the office, cheque number…
platform_payment_recorded: Payment recorded and the subscription extended
platform_suspend_hint: Closes the business to everyone in it, whatever it has paid. They are shown the reason.
platform_suspend_reason: Reason, as the business will read it
platform_resume_hint: The suspension is lifted. Whether it may work then depends on what it has paid.
platform_payments_intro: What businesses paid for their packages, and the bank transfers waiting to be checked.
platform_receipts_hint: Compare each receipt with the bank statement. Confirming extends the business's subscription at once.
platform_reject_reason: Reason, needed to reject: the business reads it
platform_receipt_confirmed: Payment confirmed and the subscription extended
platform_receipt_rejected: Receipt rejected. The business has been told why.
platform_receipt_gone: That receipt is no longer waiting: it was already decided, or replaced by a newer one.
platform_packages_intro: What businesses can subscribe to. Every package opens the whole system; they differ in people, branches and how often they are paid.
platform_pkg_highlights: Also printed on the pricing page
platform_pkg_highlights_placeholder: One line each: Priority phone support
platform_v_slug: Small letters, digits and hyphens only
platform_bank_intro: The accounts businesses transfer their subscription into. Active ones are shown on every business's Subscription page.
platform_messages_intro: What visitors wrote on the contact page.
platform_messages_none: Every message has been dealt with.
platform_message_note_placeholder: Called back, sent the price list…
